description.text: 1. Period of Study The Period of Study lasts for 2 years. Students will have a full-time study in the first year to finish all the courses in China University of Political Science and Law in Beijing. In the second year, after their registration the students can manage their time independently to carry on social internship in China or in their own country, and prepare the research paper by keeping in touch with their thesis adviser. 2. Fees Application fee is 800 RMB per person; The whole tuition fee is 99,000 RMB in total per person. The tuition fee will be paid by year: 50,000 RMB in the first year; 49,000 RMB in the second year. Pre-pay tuition is 2000 RMB per person, which is included in the whole tuition fee. 3.Accommodations Students will live in the International Students’ apartments arranged by the university, and the accomodation fee will be funded by themselves. All the admitted student will get a special scholarship provided by the university, which will be used to reduce the accommodation expenses. 4.Application and Admission Time Students can submit application materials at any time of the year; the Admission Time is in each September. 5. Curriculum

duration.text: The MBA Class in English at China University of Political Science and Law is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6944 USD/per year ￥ 50000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here. 8.Other assisted application materials for themselves 9.Copy of article or papers published Individual research achievement, contents and summaries of published academic articles and other original research achievement.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the social customs and habits6. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the CUPL. 3.Applicants must be in good health 4.The applicant must have a bachelor degree and be under the age of 50. 5.Applicant should be capable enough to accept the lessons taught in English.
